name: Devon Rhodes
source: A line cook at a pizzeria where Clyde works at. She dreams of being a professional chef and has an upbeat optimistic attitude. She befriended Clyde a few years after he joined up and is often his confidant and close friend. She’s a very good people person and is only participating in the game because Clyde needed a partner. Despite being very personable, she tends to have issues with her self-confidence and often relies on others for support.
